title: The Pink Angel Halloween Costume
intro: Angelic, technically. A hot pink ruffle chiffon mini with long sleeves, soft pink feather wings and a fluffy white halo, finished with white platform heels and a pair of rhinestone star earrings that catch every camera flash in the room. It photographs like a dream, you can sit down in it, and nobody will ask you to explain who you are supposed to be, which is more than most costumes manage. The dress goes on to a second life at birthdays, and the wings make a very convincing case for a pink Christmas tree.
